title: 3019-3025 ½ EAST 4TH STREET; BOARD FILE NO. 260052
text:
[D. PUBLIC HEARINGS regarding EXPORT-IMPORT applications pursuant to Section 91.7006.7.5]
3019-3025 ½ EAST 4TH STREET; BOARD FILE NO. 260052
  C.D.: 14 (Councilmember Ysabel Jurado); Boyle Heights Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Joaquin Greenough
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Inspection/Grading

  APPLICANT:  Kevin Riley

  Consideration of Application to export 3,425 cubic yards of earth from the project site; and
  consideration whether the project is categorically exempt under CEQA pursuant to Section 15332
  (Class 32) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines (Case No. ENV-2025-
  3782-CE), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a categorical
  exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS APPEALABLE TO THE CITY COUNCIL WITHIN TEN DAYS PURSUANT TO
  SECTION 91.7006.7.5.
summary: Consideration of application to export 3,425 cubic yards of earth from 3019-3025 ½ East 4th Street in Boyle Heights, with CEQA categorical exemption review.
